ov: Predatory arthropods with one pair of legs per body segment. All are venomous: the first pair of legs is modified into venom-injecting pincers called forcipules. Many avoid sunlight by hiding or being active at night. Females care for their eggs, often curling around them.

why.dg: All centipedes are venomous and can inflict painful stings.

len: A few millimetres to about 30 cm
df: Mostly generalist carnivores, hunting a wide range of prey.
fx: The last pair of legs is not used for walking; some species use them to grab prey or rivals, or hang from branches.
